title: packages: the 422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED remedy still tells the caller to save an item under its own name, the package-less save ADR-0146 D11 closed
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① user-facing copy that contradicts a landed decision, found by the #28579 slice 3 run (run record #29560, PR #29559 `FOLLOW-UPS.md` §15b item 5). The seat confirmed the text on `main`.
Reader: `domain:server` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`, `CUSTOMISE_BESIDE_REMEDY`, about line 618).
Dedupe (open AND closed): `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED remedy`. #24705, #24670 and #24062 (closed) are about which doors refuse, not the remedy wording. #29489 is the same stale model in the Studio landing copy.
reach: every 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`, for example `DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase`.
type: Bug

## What happens
The remedy reads: "customise what this package provides beside it, as environment-level state (ADR-0131 D6): save an item under its own name — that overlays it where the item's type takes an environment overlay…". Since ADR-0146 D11 (#28576 / #28850), that package-less save onto a packaged item is refused 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, naming the `<base>.custom` pair.

## Wanted
The remedy names the ADR-0146 route: customize in the base's `.custom` pair (`POST /api/v1/packages/<base>/ensure-customization`, then save there). Update whatever pins the text. Wording only, with no behaviour change.
